help.card.title: Déjà Vu Card
help.card.face-blue.title: Blue side
help.card.face-blue.label: Blue side
help.card.face-orange.title: Orange side
help.card.face-orange.desc: Shows <bold>two digits between 0 and 7</bold> whose sum equals the number on the blue side.
help.card.face-orange.label: Orange side (1 + 2 = 3)
help.card.unique: <bold>Each combination is unique</bold>: every card in the game is different.
help.card.observe.title: Observe
help.card.observe.desc: Secretly look at the face-down card. Only you can see it. You will then have to put it back in place.
help.card.flip.title: Reveal
help.card.flip.desc: Reveal the card face up on the grid. If it shares a digit in common with the other face-up cards, you can <bold>Terminate</bold>.
help.card.terminate.title: Terminate
help.card.terminate.desc: When the same digit appears <bold>at least 3 times</bold> among the face-up cards (a card showing the same digit twice counts double), you can Terminate: win all those cards into your pile. The grid is refilled.
help.card.bonus.title: Instinct bonus
help.card.bonus.desc: If the same digit appears <bold>4 times or more</bold> among the face-up cards, you steal an instinct token from your opponent.
help.card.fail.title: Failure
help.card.fail.desc: If the revealed card <bold>shares no digit</bold> in common with the others, all cards are turned face down and you give an instinct token to your opponent.
help.card.score.title: Score
help.card.score: Each card collected is worth 1 point.
help.end-card.title: End Card
help.end-card.description: When the End card appears on top of the deck, you can <bold>take it into your pile</bold> to trigger the end of the game.
help.end-card.last-turn: Your opponent then plays <bold>one last turn</bold>, then the game ends and scores are calculated.
help.end-card.score: The End card is worth 1 point.
help.token.title: Instinct Token
help.token.description: The first player starts with <bold>3 tokens</bold>, the second with <bold>4 tokens</bold>.
help.token.lose.title: Lose a token
help.token.lose.desc: When you reveal a card with no digit in common with the other face-up cards, you give one of your tokens to your opponent.
help.token.give.title: Give to replay
help.token.give.desc: At the end of your turn, if you have tokens, you can give one to your opponent to replay immediately.
help.token.instinct.title: Victory by instinct!
help.token.instinct.desc: If a player has <bold>7 tokens</bold>, they win the game immediately, with no score count.
help.token.score.title: Score
help.token.score.desc: At the end of the game (normal victory), each token in your possession is worth <bold>0.5 points</bold>.
tuto.welcome: Welcome to <bold>Déjà Vu</bold>! You know that sudden feeling of having already experienced a situation, even though it's new? In this mental duel, trust your memory and listen to your instinct!
tuto.cards:
In <bold>Déjà Vu</bold>, the cards have two sides: the <bold>blue side</bold> shows a number between <bold>2 and 12</bold>.
On the other side, the <bold>orange side</bold> shows two digits between <bold>0 and 7</bold> whose <bold>sum equals the blue side</bold>.
Each combination is unique!
tuto.actions.intro: On your turn, you have 2 possible actions:
tuto.actions.observe: <bold>Observe</bold>: secretly look at a face-down card without revealing it.
tuto.actions.reveal: <bold>Reveal</bold>: turn over the cards on the grid one by one, orange side up, until a success or a failure.
tuto.observe-intro: It's your turn to play. Let's start by <bold>Observing</bold> this <bold>6 card</bold> secretly, to discover the 2 digits on its <bold>orange side</bold>.
tuto.observe-see: <bold>2 + 4 = 6</bold>. Memorize this information before putting the card back in place.
tuto.end-of-turn: Click <bold>End my turn</bold> in the header to hand over to your opponent.
tuto.opponent-turn: Your opponent also <bold>Observes</bold> a card. Only they discover the 2 orange digits of this <bold>7 card</bold>.
tuto.observe-turn2: It's your turn again. This time, <bold>Observe</bold> this <bold>8 card</bold>.
tuto.observe-see-2: <bold>4 + 4 = 8</bold>. Put the card back in place once you've memorized it.
tuto.use-memory:
Now, let's discover the <bold>Reveal</bold> action.
It consists of revealing several cards to try to win them.
Let's start by revealing this <bold>9 card</bold>.
tuto.reveal:
<bold>4 + 5 = 9</bold>. Careful, your opponent sees it too!
To get a <bold>Success</bold>, you must reveal <bold>the same digit at least 3 times</bold>.
But beware: all revealed cards must show <bold>a digit in common</bold>, otherwise it's a <bold>Failure</bold>!
tuto.flip-more: If my memory serves me right, you can <bold>reveal</bold> this card without risking a failure... Go ahead!
tuto.flip-can-terminate:
The digit 4 already appears <bold>3 times</bold>: it's a <bold>Success</bold>!
You can stop there, or continue revealing cards, but if you don't reveal the digit <bold>4</bold>, it will be a <bold>Failure</bold>.
tuto.flip-fourth: Reveal this card. You observed it on the first turn, this 6 is made of <bold>2 + 4</bold>.
tuto.terminate:
The digit 4 appears <bold>4 times</bold> among the face-up cards.
Click <bold>Terminate</bold> in the header to take these 3 cards.
tuto.refill: The grid is immediately refilled with cards from the Déjà-vu deck.
tuto.terminate-result: Your cards join your <bold>pile</bold>: each card is worth <bold>1 point</bold> at the end of the game.
tuto.tokens-intro: Here are the <bold>instinct tokens</bold>: there are <bold>7</bold> in total. You have <bold>3</bold> and your opponent has <bold>4</bold>, because you are the one who started the game.
tuto.tokens-bonus: Since you revealed the same digit <bold>4 times or more</bold>, you take <bold>1 instinct token</bold> from your opponent!
tuto.tokens-instinct: If a player gathers all <bold>7 instinct tokens</bold>, they <bold>immediately</bold> win the game! Otherwise, each token is worth <bold>0.5 points</bold> at the end of the game.
tuto.end-of-turn-2:
After each action, you can <bold>give an instinct token</bold> to your opponent to replay.
Instead, click <bold>End my turn</bold> in the header.
tuto.fail-result:
There is <bold>no digit in common</bold> between the 2 revealed cards: it's a <bold>Failure</bold>!
All cards are turned face down and your opponent gives you an <bold>instinct token</bold>.
tuto.end-card:
The <bold>End card</bold> is at the bottom of the deck. Once visible, the player whose turn it is can choose to take it into their pile. This is then the only action of their turn.
The opponent then plays <bold>one last turn</bold>, before the points are counted.
tuto.conclusion:
Now it's your turn to play: trust your memory or your instinct to win!
<bold>Good luck!</bold>
